The '''Republic Power Generation''' was a region of the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Republic made use of the area's generator facilities, and the [[Lenstrum Market]] and [[Outpost Shylon]] were located in the region.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Power Generation appears as part of the Upper Industrial Sector on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
